story.summaryEn:
LAP 33/62: Tidy work from the pit crew 👏
Max ducks into the box for a set of Medium Tyres and retains the race lead! 
Oscar, who is yet to box, trails Max by just over two seconds; the Ferraris are a couple more seconds down the road.
#F1 || #SingaporeGP 🇸🇬
